title: Planting Roots for a Sustainable Future with Neighborhood Forest
summary: Join Nortech in our commitment to innovate smarter, lighter, and more sustainable solutions in manufacturing.
body_markdown:
Since 2023, Nortech has proudly partnered with[Neighborhood Forest](https://www.neighborhoodforest.org/) to bring trees to communities and children across the country. Our commitment to sustainability drives us to support initiatives that create meaningful connections between people and nature. By helping provide access to trees, we aim to foster greener, healthier communities and inspire the next generation to value and protect the environment.
Since 2010, Neighborhood Forest has been on an inspiring mission to create a greener future, one tree at a time. With the help of schools, libraries, youth groups, and companies like Nortech Systems across North America, Neighborhood Forest has planted over 310,000 trees in urban and residential areas continent wide. This effort has reached over 500,000 families and engaged 750,000 volunteers, spreading environmental stewardship to nearly every corner of the U.S, Canada and Mexico.
This unique endeavor empowers children and communities to participate directly in planting trees, fostering a lifelong connection to the environment. But Neighborhood Forest’s story doesn’t just stop at planting trees. It’s a reminder that the collective efforts of people and organizations can make a significant difference in tackling climate change and building a healthier, more sustainable planet.


## Get Involved this Earth Day


At Nortech, we recognize our responsibility to the communities and ecosystems in which we operate. With the help and efforts of our teams, Nortech has donated over 10,000 trees to the program, demonstrating our unwavering commitment to environmental sustainability and community enrichment making us a sequoia-level sponsor.
Climate change doesn’t just affect the environment; it influences global health, economies, and the well-being of future generations. For us, sustainability is not an afterthought but a core value that drives our innovation and business strategies. Our commitment to innovation and the development of more sustainable technology platforms helps to reduce our customers’ overall carbon footprint. We strive to design and develop lighter, faster and economically sound products, which is why we choose to partner with Neighborhood Forest.
Neighborhood Forest’s success is built on the power of collaboration, community, and shared values. Nortech is proud to stand with them in cultivating a world where businesses and communities come together to protect the environment.
This year, we encourage you to reflect on the steps you can take toward more sustainable practices.


## Here are some ways to get involved this Earth Day:


#### 1. Clean up your neighborhood


Many communities host cleanup events on Earth Day. Volunteer locally to pick up trash and litter restoring the areas nearest to you.


#### 2. Support sustainable causes that advocate for environmental policies


#### 3. Plant a tree


Planting trees can help improve air quality and combat climate change. Whether it’s participating in tree-planting initiatives, or reducing your carbon footprint, every action counts


Join us in our[commitment to innovate smarter, lighter, cleaner solutions](https://www.nortechsys.com/insights/digital-transformation-and-esg/) . Partner with Nortech and Neighborhood Forest, and together, let’s create a healthier, more sustainable future for generations to come.
